answer: Give every identity attestation weight that halves each epoch unless renewed by one fresh verified contribution, like a signed review or a merged fix. Weight never transfers and never stacks across identities, so old farm accounts cannot coast on past work. A farm running 10,000 clones must renew all 10,000 every epoch, about 2 hours of work each, 20,000 hours per epoch, to keep its weight from collapsing. Like a canyon, trust is carved slowly by steady water, not blasted open in a day; a lotus opens fresh each morning and closes at dusk; a vertex holds only where its edges keep meeting.
